findings.title: In everyone mode the party stats count only the ticked pawns, but every pawn goes in
findings.detail: In everyone mode DungeonEntry.Enter sends every pawn in the caravan (`party = caravan.PawnsListForReading.ToList()`), ticked or not. RecacheStats builds partyInfo from the transferables' CountToTransfer alone (MassUsageTransferables, CapacityTransferables, ApproxDaysWorthOfFood and the rest). So an unticked pack animal or downed pawn goes in but adds nothing to the mass, capacity, food or speed on screen. The item mass getter, now `partyInfo.massCapacity - partyInfo.massUsage`, then limits item picks to that lower capacity. Fix: in RecacheStats, when `everyone` is true, build partyInfo as if every pawn transferable were fully ticked, or tick every pawn when everyone mode turns on. Unticked items do correctly stay out, since they go to the stash.

findings.title: A living pawn left in the stash is now lost if the party is wiped with no caravan outside
findings.detail: FlushStash now keeps hauled pawns instead of destroying them through GiveThing, which is better. But in everyone mode there may be no caravan waiting. A downed colonist or captive hauled into the exit then waits in the stash, and if the rest of the party dies, Notify_MyMapAboutToBeRemoved calls FlushStash(null), which does nothing. The site is then removed with the pawn still in its stash. Consider making a caravan for a colonist left in the stash at that point, the same way TryMovePawnOut does for colonists who walk out.
